caveats: physical (mzLib's PtmPairEngine.Physical, type P): both modifications were identified on one peptidoform, so on one molecule. statistic is the median over runs of the co-occupancy, the intensity of peptidoforms carrying both over the intensity of peptidoforms covering both positions, on the statistic_n runs where both were quantified; n counts the runs where the doubly modified form was identified. There is no test: p_value and q are null.

The observations follow ptmqtl occupancy's rules: MS/MS identifications only, one row per (run, peptidoform, protein), and the same exclusions (Common Variable, Common Fixed, peptide-terminal and C-terminal modifications).
